entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I'm calling because I need to return something. It's the Urban Commuter Helmet I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, nothing's broken. It's just... the color. It's not what I expected at all. I know safety is the most important part, but I just can't see myself wearing it. I feel terrible about it.
I understand completely, sometimes colors can look a bit different on screen. Let me just pull up your order information. I see you received the delivery about 43 days ago, is that right?

Yes, that sounds right. I'm so sorry for the delay. I kept it hoping I'd change my mind, but I haven't. The box is still unopened, I never even took it out. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back for some other bills.

Please don't worry about it at all. Let me check the policy for you. Okay, for a standard item like this helmet, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for you.
Oh, really? You can? That's such a relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried I had waited too long.

Not at all, you're perfectly fine. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just attach that to the shipping box and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in about 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's perfect. You've been a huge help, Sarah. Thank you!
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
